name: claude-codex-settings
title_zh: 三款 CLI 共用的同一套调校好的钩子与智能体
tagline_zh: Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 三端共用一套配置，内置 Kimi、MiniMax。
tagline_en: Shared hooks, agents and settings for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor, with Kimi, MiniMax and GLM API presets ready.
desc_en: Battle-tested Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor configs, plugins, hooks and agents with Kimi, MiniMax and GLM API support.
why_zh: 把散落在三处工具的配置、钩子、智能体收拢成一份，改一处三端生效，还预置了国产 API 的接入样板。
why_en: Centralizes configs across three tools so one edit applies everywhere, plus ready-made adapters for Chinese model APIs.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 三款 CLI 工具；不含 IDE 图形界面配置。
limit_en: Only covers Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor CLIs; no GUI IDE settings, no API key signup or billing.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: One tuned config with hooks & agents for three CLIs
